'''''Star Wars: Crimson Empire''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series of three story arcs published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] and written by [[Mike Richardson]] and [[Randy Stradley]]. The first mini-series, titled [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire|''Crimson Empire'']], was launched in [[December]] [[1997]], concluding in [[May]] [[1998]]. The followup series, [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'']], was released in [[November]] of that year, concluding in [[April]] [[1999]]. After the end of the second story arc, a third was planned for release in [[2001]] and the one shot comic ''[[Hard Currency]]'' was released as an introduction to the new storyline. However, the project was shelved for a decade, finally being revived and released from [[October]] [[2011]] to [[April]] [[2012]] as ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost|Star Wars: Crimson Empire III—Empire Lost]]'', the conclusion to the series storyline.

Set in the [[New Republic era]] immediately following the end of ''[[Star Wars: Empire's End]]'', the finale of the ''Dark Empire'' comic series trilogy, ''Crimson Empire'' follows the life of [[Kir Kanos]], a former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|royal guard]] whose duty in life was to protect [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Following the final death of Palpatine during the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Onderon]] and the [[Attack on the Imperial Royal Guard Academy|slaughter]] of the rest of his kin on [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]], Kir Kanos is left with a blood oath against the enemies of the Empire, swearing death to all involved in the death of his former master. The first storyline focused on the conflict between Kanos and [[Carnor Jax]], a former Imperial Royal Guard and aspiring [[Lumiya's Sith|Sith Lord]] who made a bid for the throne following Palpatine's death, while the followup series chronicled Kanos' time as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and his targeting of members of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]]. The third and final series focused on both Kanos' desire to kill [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who was the main rival of the former Emperor, and his conflict with [[Ennix Devian|Devian]], a former Imperial "thug" leading a splinter faction of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] known as the "[[Restored Empire]]."

In addition to the three story arcs and various one off comics, an [[Crimson Empire (audio drama)|audio dramatization]] of the first ''Crimson Empire'' was released in 1999.
